scope.purpose: Stand in for content that is loading with its shape and size, so that the layout does not move when it arrives.
useCases: Lines of text in a card or a list.
exclusions: Composite skeletons (a card skeleton): compositions of Skeletons in examples.
alternatives: Spinner for a short action on existing content.

checks.name: npm run validate (schema, consistency, token coverage in 18 contexts, dependencies)
npm run build:tokens (coverage and contrast evidence)

decisionsTaken: Three shapes (text, block, circle); text lines follow typography.body.{size}: a bar of the font size centered in the line box, so that a skeleton paragraph has the height of the real one.
Painted in color.surface.muted, pulsing to opacity.muted (0.7) once per motion.duration.loop, no pulse under reduced motion.
Radii: radius.indicator for text, radius.container for blocks, radius.full for circles.
Hidden from assistive technology; the busy state belongs to the loading region (integration).
nextAction: Wave 3 contract gate: present the contract with the other wave 3 contracts and record the approval.
